_comment: This setup's realm, the source of truth. Applied by deploy/keycloak/apply_realm.py through the admin API: what is absent is created; anything present that differs is refused by name, never overwritten. No secrets here: the Enclave client's secret is generated by Keycloak and read straight into the Enclave's vault.

roles.name: openshell-admin
roles.description: Administers this setup's gateway and desk workspace. The customer's administrators only.

roles.name: openshell-user
roles.description: Uses desks in the desk workspace. People, and the Enclave's machine identity.

clientScopes.name: openshell:all
clientScopes.description: Every OpenShell operation the person's ROLE allows; the role, enforced at the gateway, is the limit.

clientScopes.name: sandbox:write
clientScopes.description: Run in sandboxes (ExecSandbox). Create and delete are refused for the Enclave by EKKA's interceptor.

clientScopes.name: provider:read
clientScopes.description: Read providers and their profiles (GetProvider, GetProviderProfile). OpenShell answers credential names, never values. The Enclave pins each desk's providers with it.

clientScopes.name: workspace:read
clientScopes.description: Read the workspaces a person belongs to (OpenShell workspace:read). Read only.

clientScopes.name: config:read
clientScopes.description: Read gateway and desk configuration and policy status (OpenShell config:read). Read only.
